Reported Spill Volume: 20 gallons
THE RELEASE OCCURRED AT A REGIONAL SOLID WASTE-TO-ENERGY FACILITY. CLEANING OPERATIONS WERE BEING PERFORMED INSIDE THE FACILITY WHERE POWER WASHING WAS BEING PERFORMED. CLEANING GENERATED WASTE WATER THAT CONTAINED INCINERATOR ASH RESIDUES FROM THE EQUIPMENT BEING CLEANED. THE WASTE WATER COLLECTED IN THE METALS BAY AREA AND EXITED THE BUILDING. APPROXIMATELY 20 GALLONS OF WASTE WATER WAS RELEASED. CONTAMINANTS OF CONCERN INCLUDE HEAVY METALS. THE RELEASE WAS LIMITED TO PAVEMENT AND DID NOT ENTER STORM DRAINS, CONTACT SOIL, OR ENTER SURFACE WATER. THE RELEASE WAS IMMEDIATELY CONTAINED WITH SPEEDI-DRY AND CLEANED UP. THE RELEASE WAS REPORTED TO THE MA-DEP AND ASSIGNED RELEASE TRACKING NUMBER 2-18113.

CLEANING GENERATED WASTE WATER THAT CONTAINED INCINERATOR ASH RESIDUES FROM THE EQUIPMENT BEING CLEANED. THE WASTE WATER COLLECTED IN THE METALS BAY AREA AND EXITED THE BUILDING. APPROXIMATELY 20 GALLONS OF WASTE WATER WAS RELEASED. CONTAMINANTS OF CONCERN INCLUDE HEAVY METALS. THE RELEASE WAS LIMITED TO PAVEMENT AND DID NOT ENTER STORM DRAINS, CONTACT SOIL, OR ENTER SURFACE WATER. THE RELEASE WAS IMMEDIATELY CONTAINED WITH SPEEDI-DRY AND CLEANED UP. THE RELEASE WAS REPORTED TO THE MA-DEP AND ASSIGNED RELEASE TRACKING NUMBER 2-18113.

SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 52.210909, -174.203583 (Approximated from route)
Report DescriptionCALLER IS REPORTING A SCHOOL THAT IS IN VIOLATION OF THE CLEAN WATER ACT. SOME OF THE SCHOOLS EQUIPMENT HAS BEEN NEGLECTED FOR YEARS AND HAS BEEN LEAKING UNKNOWN AMOUNTS OF AN UNKNOWN OIL INTO THE GROUND AND POSSIBLY INTO NAZON BAY AND A SALMON STREAM. CALLER STATED THE GENERATOR THAT WAS BEING USED AT THE SCHOOL WAS LEAKING ABOUT 1 GALLON A WEEK FOR 2 TO 15 YEARS ONTO THE GROUND AND POSSIBLE SOAKING INTO NAZON BAY. IN ADDITION, THE SCHOOL ADDED ABOVE GROUND STORAGE TANKS TO REPLACE THE UNDERGROUND STORAGE TANKS THAT WERE LEAKING, BUT THE UNDERGROUND TANKS WERE NEVER DISCONNECTED AND ARE STILL TIED TO THE ABOVE GROUND TANKS. SO THE UNDERGROUND TANKS STILL HAVE OIL RUNNING THROUGH THEM AND THE TANKS ARE LEAKING INTO THE GROUND SUBSURFACE. THE SCHOOL ALSO HAS SOME HOUSING THAT IS CONNECTED TO THE GENERATOR AND STORAGE TANKS AS WELL AND THE PIPING THAT GOES TO THE HOUSE TO PROVIDE THE OIL IS ALSO LEAKING INTO THE GROUND. CALLER ESTIMATES THE LEAK RATE ON THAT PIPING IS AT LEAST 7 GALLONS A MONTH OVER A LONG PERIOD OF TIME. CALLER HAS PHOTOS AND VIDEO TO PROVIDE IF NEEDED. CALLER STATED THIS WAS INITIALLY REPORTED TO THE DEP AND THEY HAVEN"T TAKEN ANY ACTION TO CLEAN UP OR MITIGATE THE ISSUES. CALLER STATED THE LEAKING GENERATOR HAS BEEN ADDRESSED AND STOPPED, BUT THE SPILLS FROM THE GENERATOR WERE NEVER CLEANED UP.
